first_error_behavior: Main Validate and each schedule validator alert and return on the first active failing branch; schedule validators run only when their modal OK action is used.

rules.accepted_behavior: A parseable value is converted to two decimals.
rules.rejected_behavior: NaN becomes 0.00; JavaScript binary floating-point is used.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use bounded decimal parsing and explicit rounding.

rules.accepted_behavior: A parseable value is rounded to zero decimals.

rules.condition: Schedule 2, 6, 7, or 8 is opened with year <= 2000.
rules.accepted_behavior: Year greater than 2000 opens the schedule.
rules.exact_message: Please input a valid Return period year. Please enter 2000 above.
rules.official_behavior: The duplicated conjunction <=2000 && <=2020 reduces to <=2000, so year 2000 is rejected although Validate accepts it.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use the same inclusive >=2000 rule in every phase.

rules.condition: Schedule 1 OK is clicked with zero/blank sales or output tax.
rules.accepted_behavior: The modal closes despite the invalid row.
rules.rejected_behavior: No rejection occurs; the intended alert is commented out.
rules.official_behavior: Schedule 1 row validation is an intentional no-op after a QAD change.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require selected ATC rows to have valid sales and a recomputed output tax.

Please enter valid data.\n Aggregate amount should not exceed P1 Million.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use decimal comparison and clarify whether the statutory cap is per row or aggregate.

rules.condition: Schedule 2 date does not split into three numeric components.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid date for Date of Purchase on row {row}.\nPlease enter a date in the MM/DD/YYYY format.

rules.condition: Schedule 2 date has an impossible day or, except February, is outside the return month/year.
rules.exact_message: Invalid entry on row {row}. Date of Purchase must be within the Return Period only.
rules.official_behavior: Month 02 skips the return-period comparison entirely; month/day lower bounds and unknown months are also not checked.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use a real date and require exact return month/year.
